# Oura sandbox fixtures

These files are **Oura's public sandbox data** (synthetic sample data from Oura's API v2 sandbox,
`https://api.ouraring.com/v2/sandbox/usercollection/...`), not anyone's real ring data. Pulled 2026-11-23 with
`python -m hub.oura_app --sandbox pull --days 30` and copied from `data/oura/sandbox/`.
Never add anything from `data/oura/live/` here.
